item.title: Major Reshuffle in Assam Police, 17 Officers Get New Postings
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Government of Assam on Monday, March 2, ordered a major reshuffle in the state police administration, transferring and reassigning 17 IPS and APS officers across key positions. The notification, issued by the Home (A) Department from Janata Bhawan in Dispur, said the transfers were made in the interest of public service.
